none: PAS CAM-2358C1: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine. AD330-335, (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads GLORIA EXERCITVS. Reverse shows Two Soldier, two standards. Mint unknown. Obverse shows Bust right. Obverse legend is illegible. Reverse fields and exergue read: wreath//[...]. This coin was struck at Trier or Arles. Condition is fine. Die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 1.46g, diameter is 16.7mm
